name: TiberbuServiceProtocol
title: tibERbu Service Protocol
description: Tracks a patient's progress through tibERbu-sourced clinical events. Currently covers Consent, from initiation through verification: step patient-consent-initiated matches a proposed, unverified Patient Consent (LOINC 59284-0) — see artifacts/Consent Payload Structures - OTP, Afyayangu, Biometrics.json. Its sub-step patient-consent-verified matches the same Consent once verification completes (status flips to active, verification.verified flips to true) — see artifacts/Consent Payload Structures - Verified Consent.json. Each step combines a Tier-1 structural codeFilter (status + category) with a Tier-2 FHIRPath condition on verification.verified; neither step restricts which verification channel (OTP/Afyayangu/Biometrics) was used. Further tibERbu event types (Encounter, EpisodeOfCare, ...) are expected to be added as additional top-level steps over time.

action.title: Patient Consent Initiated
action.description: A Patient Consent proposed but not yet verified: Consent.status = 'proposed', Consent.category = LOINC 59284-0 (Patient Consent) — both Tier-1 structural codeFilters. The FHIRPath condition (Tier 2) confirms verification.verified = false. No restriction on which verification channel (OTP/Afyayangu/Biometrics) was used.

action.title: Patient Consent Verified
action.description: The same Patient Consent, now verified: Consent.status = 'active', Consent.category = LOINC 59284-0 (Patient Consent) — both Tier-1 structural codeFilters. The FHIRPath condition (Tier 2) confirms verification.verified = true. Sub-step of patient-consent-initiated.
